figures.caption: Figure 1: Overview of our retrieval-augmented lexical code-switching pipeline. Given a user prompt, a base GPT model first produces an English response; we dependency-parse this response to extract content words, use them to query a Singlish lexicon via semantic search, then concatenate the retrieved lexical entries back into the prompt for a second GPT pass that generates the final, lexically code-switched response.
Figure 2: Edit distance versus semantic similarity for zero-shot prompting and RAG. The x-axis is capped for readability.
